name: China Seismic Network phase picker benchmark
description: An evaluation suite measuring the accuracy and computational efficiency of neural-network-based seismic phase pickers using datasets from the China Seismic Network.
evaluation_method: precision / recall / F1 for detection; mean absolute error (MAE) for pick-time accuracy
reputation: Widely used within the seismology community for benchmarking neural-network phase pickers on China Seismic Network data.
notes: Non-LLM time-series benchmark; labels have inherent uncertainty (pick time variability); performance depends on SNR and station coverage; dataset is region/instrument-specific which can limit generalization; class imbalance (many noise windows) is common.
